_comment: Expected result after the function runs, assuming the Gracenote Program Details API returns HTTP 200 for an Episode-type program. Values are illustrative. Note: content_tms_id is passed through $encodeUrlComponent() before being placed in the URL; a plain TMS ID like EP006883590001 encodes to itself, but any special characters would be percent-encoded.
